description: Makes the edit faster paced, slower and more cinematic, or back to normal, as one undoable change. By default (amount a_little) every other shot takes a half-length or double-length beat-aligned step; amount a_lot steps every shot, for much faster or much slower. A shot whose length or speed was already chosen keeps it unless named. The first and last shots and AI+ shots keep their fixed length. The video stays on the song's beat grid; read_music_structure shows where the cuts now land.

amount.description: Default a_little. a_lot only for 'much faster' or 'much slower'.

photoIds.description: Optional: only these shots. Default: every shot.

items.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

name: set_pace
title: Pace
